title: ForgeAccountVerifiedPayload

forgeAccountId.description: A forge account's id: a version 4 UUID the adding client mints, kept in lowercase.

login.description: The login the forge's user endpoint answered, which may change while the user id stays.

userId.description: The forge's numeric user id as decimal digits, a string so that no JSON reader rounds it: what makes a credential the same identity.

anyOf.description: Who a forge account's credential answers as: its login and the forge's user id.

state.description: Whether a forge account can do something: verified (a probe or an operation succeeded), failed (refused) or unknown (not tried yet).

anyOf.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

verifiedAt.description: When it was last found verified; null until it has been.

status.description: The HTTP status a failure answered; null unless it failed.

readRepository.description: What is known of one capability: its state, when it was last verified, and a failure's status.

capabilities.description: Each of a forge account's five capabilities: readRepository, writeIssues, pullRequests, createRepository and readReleases.

kind.description: What kind of token a credential is: classic, fine-grained, oauth, or unknown (a Forgejo or Gitea token, which does not say).

scopes.description: The scopes the forge's scope header named, a hint only; null when it sent none.

anyOf.description: An instant as an ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

expiresAt.description: When the token expires, when the forge says; null otherwise.

anyOf.description: What a verification read of a forge account's token: its kind, the scope header as a hint, and its expiry.

kind.description: What is wrong with a forge account: needs-credential (a copy with none), credential-rejected (401 on its identity), credential-unavailable (the key manager or gh signed out, or the vault entry missing), identity-changed (another user id answered; unused until the credential is replaced), unreachable (the forge did not answer) or expiring (the token expires within thirty days).

since.description: Since when the forge account has had this problem.

message.description: One plain line for people: what is wrong and what to do. It holds no HTTP status, user id or exact time: those are in details.

details.description: The raw facts behind the line; absent when there are none, and on a problem recorded before details were.

anyOf.description: A forge account's problem: which, since when, one plain line saying what to do, and the raw facts behind it.

description: forge.account.verified: a verification found the identity, a capability, the token information or the problem changed; what it found, whole.
